title: Coherence of already constructed normalized derived comparisons
statement: For a cartesian algebra-diagram adjunction presentation p as defined in [def-pur-algebra-diagram-normalization-interface], take the canonical unbounded derived categories and the proved exactness structures on its constant evaluations. Given normalized ordinary comparisons o from [lem-pur-algebra-diagram-normalized-ordinary-comparisons] and derived comparisons d, beta, delta, dj, qaB, qaA satisfying the six right-derived-unit square equations, the derived counit and arbitrary transpose equations, coefficient cube, and the actual-arrow transition equations on varying and constant coefficients hold. This result assumes the comparisons and proves their coherence.

source.place: Tags 07A6 and 0D6E, normalized diagram direct image and derived composition.

proof.text: The normalized square counit theorem identifies the derived counit with the localized ordinary mate. The transpose formula follows from counit naturality. For coefficients, the two ordinary routes agree after faithful forgetting to set-valued sheaves; naturality of unit-normalized derived squares yields the cube. For each actual arrow apply the analogous ordinary transition equation and the normalized derived transition theorem.

proof_origin.place: The ordinary and derived normalization parts of the parent proof.

theorem derivedComparisonCoherence
    (hd : AlgebraDiagramDerivedSquareNormalized p.fB.modules p.fA.modules
      p.rX p.rY o.c d)
    (hbeta : ∀ j : J, AlgebraDiagramDerivedSquareNormalized
      p.fB.modules (p.fj j).modules (p.eBX j) (p.eBY j) (o.cB j) (beta j))
    (hdelta : ∀ j : J, AlgebraDiagramDerivedSquareNormalized
      p.fA.modules p.s.modules (p.eAX j) (p.eAY j) (o.cA j) (delta j))
    (hdj : ∀ j : J, AlgebraDiagramDerivedSquareNormalized
      (p.fj j).modules p.s.modules (p.rXj j) (p.rYj j) (o.cj j) (dj j))
    (hqaB : ∀ {j k : J} (a : j ⟶ k), AlgebraDiagramDerivedSquareNormalized
      (p.fj k).modules (p.fj j).modules
      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u} (algebraDiagramRingArrow p.BX a))
      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u} (algebraDiagramRingArrow p.BY a))
      (o.caB a) (qaB a))
    (hqaA : ∀ {j k : J} (a : j ⟶ k), AlgebraDiagramDerivedSquareNormalized
      p.s.modules p.s.modules
      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u} (algebraDiagramRingArrow p.AX a))
      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u} (algebraDiagramRingArrow p.AY a))
      (o.caA a) (qaA a)) :
    p.DerivedComparisonCoherence o d beta delta dj qaB qaA
